business_summary.text: Camlin Fine Sciences Limited is a specialty chemicals company with three segments: Specialty Ingredients (straights and blends), Aroma (vanillin production), and Performance Chemicals (downstream chemicals).

call_points.text: US vanillin volumes guided at 2,200-2,400 MT for FY27, with Q1 showing growth over Q4FY26.
Ethyl vanillin campaign of 600 MT, with 50% of the order book already covered.
Management is seeking structured and bank debt; equity infusion is a last resort.
CFS Europe liquidation removes ₹50-60 Cr of annual cash burn from next quarter.
Freight costs are three times pre-war levels and logistics remain unpredictable, with no quick normalisation expected.

guidance.statement: FY27 vanillin blended realisation guided at $13.5-14/kg
FY27 US vanillin volumes guided at 2,200-2,400 MT
FY27 Blends business revenue targeted above ₹1,400 Cr

industry: Commodities > Chemicals > Chemicals & Petrochemicals > Specialty Chemicals

operating_notes.text: Filed draft mandatory simplified cash tender offer on May 4, 2026 to acquire remaining 16.18% stake in Vinpai at EUR 3.60/share; holds 83.82% stake as of filing date.
Postal ballot approved ordinary resolution for increase in Authorized Share Capital and amendment to Clause V of MoA on May 7, 2026 with 99.99% votes in favour.
Final Monitoring Agency Report confirms full utilization of ₹224.68 Cr Rights Issue proceeds towards debt repayment (₹169.05 Cr) and general corporate purposes (₹54.94 Cr).
Shut down Dahej Diphenol Plant (FY25 turnover ₹43.52 Cr / 5.06% of sales) due to geopolitical raw material constraints; evaluating re-purposing.
Reported fire incident on May 23, 2026 at Dahej Diphenol plant causing ~₹2 Cr estimated loss (covered by insurance).
Vanillin realisation rose from sub-$11/kg in Q3FY26 to $12.5+/kg in Q4FY26 after the US tariff cut to 15.5%.
Catechol inventory of about 3,000 MT covers 8-9 months of vanillin production; hydroquinone is now imported from China.
Blends business closed FY26 at ₹1,050 Cr including discontinued operations, with FY27 target above ₹1,400 Cr.
Q1FY27 vanillin production: 560 tons (350 tons ethyl vanillin, 200 tons methyl vanillin)
Vanillin capacity utilization at 25% in Q1FY27, expected to reach 60-70% in FY27
Diphenol plant remains shut down due to high raw material prices; decision on alternate use expected in Q3FY27

timeline.summary: Anfima NV, via authorized signatory **Jens Van Nieuwenborgh**, declares no new encumbrances on Camlin Fine Sciences shares as of April 2, 2026.
Infinity Direct Holdings, promoter of Camlin Fine Sciences Limited, declared no new encumbrances on its shares as of April 2, 2026, per SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Infinity Portfolio Holdings, via Director Shewinrao Ladkoo, declared no new encumbrances on Camlin Fine Sciences shares beyond prior disclosures by March 31, 2026.
Filed draft simplified cash tender offer with French AMF for remaining shares of Vinpai at EUR 3.60/share.
Shareholders approved increase in authorized share capital via postal ballot on May 7, 2026 with 99.99% votes in favour.
Monitoring Agency Report confirms 100% utilization of ₹224.68 Cr Rights Issue proceeds with no deviation.
Camlin Fine Sciences announced the shutdown of its Dahej Diphenol Plant due to raw material constraints and disclosed a minor fire incident causing ~₹2 Cr loss.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹424.81 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹88.2 Cr (against a loss of ₹0.72 Cr a year earlier).

Camlin Fine Sciences Limited shared the audio recording of its conference call on March 31, 2026 audited results, held May 26, 2026, with **Ashish Dandekar (Chairman & MD), Nirmal Momaya (MD), and Santosh Parab (CFO)**.

Camlin Fine Sciences' May 26, 2026 Q4FY26 earnings call kept FY27 guidance at ₹2,200-2,400 Cr revenue and 12-14% EBITDA margin, with vanillin realisation guided at $13.5-14/kg and total debt at ₹670 Cr.
Camlin Fine Sciences Limited held Q1FY27 earnings conference call on August 11, 2026, guiding FY27 revenue at ₹2,200-2,300 Cr with EBITDA margin of 10-11%
Shareholders approved Mr. Atul Pradhan (DIN:00171022) as Non-Executive Independent Director via postal ballot on October 16, 2026, with 99.97% voting in favor.

watchlist.text: French Stock Markets Authority (AMF) approval of draft tender offer
Filing of amended Memorandum of Association with Registrar of Companies (RoC).

watchlist.response: Management said 300 MT remains in channel stock to be sold in Q1, and the 600 MT campaign covers the rest.
watchlist.text: Analyst pressed on why Q4 vanillin volumes were only 320 MT despite 650 MT held in channel stock.

watchlist.response: Management said raw material costs rose at least $1.20/kg and conversion adds $1.5, leaving a $3/kg spread, not the analyst's assumption.
watchlist.text: Analyst questioned the FY27 EBITDA bridge, noting vanillin alone should contribute ₹200 Cr.

watchlist.response: Management said cost is difficult to assess and it will be a mix of structured and bank debt; equity is a last resort.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked about the cost and structure of the planned debt raise.

watchlist.response: Management expects sequential margin improvement from Q2 as raw material costs stabilize and capacity utilization ramps up
watchlist.text: Raw material cost pressures and elongated working capital cycle impacting margins
